correctness.rationale: For any nontrivial bipartition, partial transpose moves the cat-state off-diagonal entry into a \(2\times2\) block with eigenvalues \(\pm|c|\), so \(\mathcal N=\frac12\sqrt{n_x^2+n_y^2}\), independent of \(N\) and the split. The restricted Hilbert--Schmidt metric is Euclidean in Bloch coordinates, hence normalized measure is uniform ball volume. Radius and direction are independent with \(R^2\sim\operatorname{Beta}(3/2,1)\) and \(1-Z^2\sim\operatorname{Beta}(1,1/2)\). Cylindrical shells give \(f_E(e)=12e\sqrt{1-4e^2}\) and therefore \(4E^2\sim\operatorname{Beta}(1,3/2)\). Direct integration gives \(\mathbb E E=3\pi/32\) and \(\mathbb E E^2=1/10\), and the CDF expansion gives the stated tube law. The verifier numerically checks normalization, moments, derivative, conditional decomposition, and higher moment factorization; it is supplementary to the analytic derivation.
